messages:
sylvie: Quick follow-up from the postmortem (INC-5842). We're greenlit for short remediations and need one owner for long-term guardrails so this class of span-loss/aggregation bugs doesn't recur.
kai: I will own the partition reprocess flow + verification. Plan: targeted backfills for affected partitions and a lightweight equivalence check. ETA: 48h.
renee: I'll take aggregation regression tests and CI gating. Adding null/edge-case cases and a nightly synthetic-trace smoke job.
sylvie: Please open obs tickets, tag postmortem:INC-5842 and mark "quick" vs "structural". Put due dates and list blockers.
kai: Backfill SQL (sample):
```sql
INSERT INTO spans_agg (trace_id, span_id, start_ts, payload)
SELECT r.trace_id, r.span_id, r.start_ts, r.payload
FROM raw_events r
LEFT JOIN spans_agg s ON s.trace_id = r.trace_id AND s.span_id = r.span_id
WHERE r.event_type='span' AND r.partition_date='2026-03-18' AND s.trace_id IS NULL;
```
I will post row counts and runtime estimate in OBS ticket.
renee: CI: nightly synthetic traces asserting >=99.9% span preservation; failures open OBS-CI with diffs. Also adding a staging pre-merge check for aggregation changes.
monitor-bot: Created OBS-4001: "etl-targeted-backfill" assigned to kai (due 2026-04-05).
monitor-bot: Created OBS-4002: "aggregation-ci-smoke" assigned to renee (due 2026-04-06).
sylvie: Operational guardrails: add partition watermark alerts, low-noise weekly span-coverage job, and a monthly 30-min "obs regression trends" sync. Who can commit to monthly?
kai: I'll attend monthly and bring partition skew metrics + backfill cost.
renee: I'll join and bring CI failure timeline + test gaps.
sylvie: Good. Everyone drop 2 bullets into your OBS ticket by EOD Tuesday: scope, ETA, blockers. I'll schedule three weekly check-ins to follow progress. Ping me if you need burst capacity or escalations.
kai: Found a delayed compaction in one partition that explains the lag; adding remediation steps in ticket.
renee: If backfill compute is heavy, we'll request short-term burst capacity from infra and list approvals needed.
sylvie: Thanks all, closing this thread until tickets have the bullets. Reopen if urgent. :rocket:
